entry.name: jit.gl.buffer
entry.digest: A buffer of mesh data on the GPU
entry.description: The jit.gl.buffer object is a named reference to a buffer of data stored on the GPU. The data is rendered via jit.gl.mesh, and jit.gl.tf is used to perform transform feedback effects.

attributes.name: instance_div
attributes.digest: Instance Division
attributes.description: Divides the buffer by the value and applies the values across the total number of instances (default = 1). For example, could be used to create color groups in a large array of mesh instances. Requiresenabled.

attributes.name: instanced
attributes.digest: Instance Enable
attributes.description: Enabling allows the buffer texture to pass different values to each drawn instance of a mesh when usingto perform hardware instancing (default = 0).

attributes.name: map
attributes.digest: Map buffer contents to named jit.matrix object
attributes.description: Takes the name of an existingobject. When set the buffer data will be written to the named matrix every frame. The destination matrix will adapt dimensions and type appropriately to contain the contents of the buffer.To clear the mapping send themessage with no arguments.

attributes.digest: Texture Buffer Enable
attributes.description: When enabled, the buffer is bound as a 1D texture buffer (default = 0). This allows for texture-style lookups in the shader code using thecommand.
